meta.title: ostra
meta.description: ostra connects your tracker to your coding agents.

common.adminsOnly: Only an admin of the organization can see this page.

errors.signedOut: You're signed out. Sign in again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. The log has the details.
errors.notFound: There's nothing here, or you can't see it.

shell.searchPlaceholder: Go to a project or a page…

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.lede: Use your username or email, and your password.
signIn.failed: That username or email and password don't match.
signIn.tooMany: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
signIn.tagline: Self-hosted cloud agents for your team.

changePassword.title: Choose a new password
changePassword.lede: This install still uses the default password. Choose your own before you go on.

defaultPassword.label: Default password
defaultPassword.lead: The default password is still in use.
defaultPassword.detail: Anyone who knows it can sign in as you.

home.title: Home
home.lede: Your organization's projects and what waits on you.
home.noProjects: No projects yet. An admin creates the first one.
home.noProjectsAdmin: No projects yet. Create one from the checklist.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.runnerJoinedPersonal: Runner {runner} joined as a personal runner

panel.chart: Pull requests opened per day, the last 7 days: {counts}

admin.title: Create the first admin
admin.body: You're signed in as the admin.

model.title: Add a model provider
model.body: A base URL and a token. ostra lists the models and tests the connection.

github.title: Connect GitHub
github.body: A GitHub App opens every pull request. Use an existing App or create one.

project.title: Create a project
project.body: Pick a repo. ostra drafts its environment from the repo's files.

runner.title: Connect a runner
runner.body: Run one command on a machine. Tasks run there.

task.title: Start the first task
task.body: Type a prompt and watch the agent work, then review its pull request.

models.title: Models
models.lede: Any provider with an API base URL and a token. Names, logos, limits and prices come from the models.dev catalog. Agents reach a provider through ostra's key proxy, so its token never reaches the agent.
models.addLede: Test the connection first: ostra detects the API format and lists the models.
models.noProviders: No provider yet. Add one in the panel on the right.
models.name: Name
models.tokenHelp: Stored in the secret store, and never shown again.
models.formatHelp: Detected by the test. Correct it if the endpoint speaks the other one.
models.sessionsCapHelp: The most sessions that use this provider at the same time. Empty: no cap.
models.allowPersonalHelp: Off by default. A personal runner is a member's own machine: a key the key proxy holds there can be read by that member.
models.selectHint: Select a provider or a model to see its properties.
models.isDefault: The built-in OpenCode profile uses this model.
models.customTitle: Custom model: not in the catalog

github.title: GitHub
github.lede: A GitHub App opens every pull request, as its own bot, with the member as co-author. ostra mints a token for one repo at a time and never hands it to an agent.
github.privateKeyHelp: The App's PEM file. Paste it or pick the file. It goes to the secret store.
github.ownerHelp: Empty: the App belongs to your own GitHub account.
github.createHelp: GitHub asks you to confirm, then sends you back here.
github.noInstallations: The App isn't installed anywhere yet. Install it on GitHub, on the org that holds your repos.
github.noPublicAddress: This server's address isn't public, so the App is created without a webhook and receives no events. Set {setting} to turn them on.
github.reposFailed: GitHub did not list the installation's repos
github.permissionsHelp: checks and actions are asked for from the start, so no install re-approves later.
github.workflowsHelp: A push that touches {path} fails, and the task says why.

projects.title: Project
projects.newLede: A project is one repo and its environment. Tasks run against it and open their pull requests there.
projects.needsGitHubBody: A project's repo comes from the GitHub App's installation.
projects.name: Name
projects.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens make its slug.
projects.noRepos: The App sees no repository in this installation. Add one on GitHub.
projects.createHelp: Nothing runs yet. You review the environment next.
projects.reposSeen: The GitHub App sees {n} repositories in {account}.
projects.reposSeenOne: The GitHub App sees 1 repository in {account}.
projects.trackerNoneHelp: Tasks start from prompts typed in ostra.
projects.trackerLinearHelp: Tickets on a team's board become tasks.
projects.draftEmpty: Pick a repository to see what ostra finds in it.
projects.draftNote: Read from the repo's files. No agent, no model.
projects.draftFailed: You can still create the project and fill in the environment by hand.

environment.title: Environment
environment.lede: What every task of this project gets before its agent starts: the setup script, and each repo's variables, secrets and files.
environment.createdLede: ostra drafted this from the repo's files. Check it, fill in the secrets, and save.
environment.name: Name
environment.duringSetupHelp: Also available while the setup script runs.
environment.baseImageHelp: Applies on the docker executor only. Tasks on a personal runner (host) use the machine as it is.
environment.nothingFound: Nothing to go on: the repo has no lockfile or setup file ostra knows.
environment.servicesHelp: A service needs a container runtime, so a personal runner (host) doesn't start it. Services come with milestone 3.
environment.setupScriptNote: runs with bash in the task's workspace, before the agent starts
environment.noEntries: No variables, secrets or files yet.
environment.footnote: For dev and test credentials, never production ones. A secret reaches only its own repo's checkout.
environment.servicesShort: A personal runner doesn't start services. They come with milestone 3.

runners.title: Runners
runners.ledeAdmin: Where tasks run. {online} of {total} runners online, {busy} of {slots} boxes busy, across {across}.
runners.ledeMember: Where tasks run. Your machine runs the tasks you send to it.
runners.noPools: No pools yet. A pool runs tasks on your servers; add one with New pool.
runners.noRunners: No runner has joined yet. Start one with a join token from a pool.
runners.connectAnother: Connect another machine: run this in a clone of ostra, then approve the code it prints.
runners.connectFirst: Connect your machine: run this in a clone of ostra, then approve the code it prints.
runners.hostNote: Personal runners use the host executor: the agent runs as a process on your machine, not isolated.
runners.hostNoteWindows: A process the agent detaches isn't contained.
runners.shownOnce: Shown once. Stored only as a hash.
runners.revokeBody: Runners that already joined stay connected. No new runner can join with it.
runners.noPoolSelected: Select a pool to see its join tokens.
runners.poolRequiresApproval: Require approval for each new runner
runners.poolNameTaken: A pool with that name exists.

device.title: Approve a runner
device.lede: Enter the code ostra runner printed on your machine.
device.ledeConfirm: Check that this code matches the one in your terminal.
device.codeHelp: Letters and digits. The dash doesn't matter.
device.unknownCode: That code isn't known, or it expired. Run ostra runner again for a new one.
device.doesPersonal: It becomes your personal runner in {organization}.
device.doesOwnTasks: It runs only the tasks you send to it.
device.notIsolated: Personal, not isolated: the agent runs as a process on that machine, as you.
device.approveOnly: Approve only if you ran {command} yourself, just now. If you didn't, deny it.
device.failed: That didn't work. The code may have expired.
device.approved: Approved. The runner finishes signing in on its own, then shows on the Runners page.
device.denied: Denied. The runner can't sign in with that code.

task.imageRemote: Image not shown: it's on another server.
task.endedWithoutChanges: The session ended without changes: no pull request.
task.driverChanged: {name} is driving now ({by} handed it over)
task.unsupported: An event this panel doesn't know:

approval.title: Needs you · approval
approval.readOnly: The agent asked to run this. Answering comes in milestone 3.

composer.label: Message the agent
composer.hint: Send queues. Interrupt and send stops the current turn.
composer.notDriver: {name} is driving. Take over to send messages.
composer.noDriver: Nobody is driving. Take over to send messages.

tasks.none: No tasks yet. Type a prompt above.

needsYouReason.question: Waiting for an answer
needsYouReason.environmentProposal: A change to the environment to review
needsYouReason.restoreConflict: Its saved work conflicts with the branch

newTask.title: New task
newTask.lede: Type what the agent should do. It works on its own branch and opens a pull request.
newTask.placeholder: Add a short CONTRIBUTING.md that explains how to run the tests
newTask.hostHelp: {runner} is your own machine. The agent runs in a worktree there, not isolated.
newTask.profileReadOnly: The project's default code profile. Agent profiles come with F-021.
newTask.nextBox: A box of {repo} from {base}, on one of the project's pools
newTask.nextPr: It opens a pull request. Steer it while it runs, and reopen it any time.

taskPage.needsYouDefault: The agent stopped and waits on a person.
